lines.t: [Intro instrumental build up]
[Low war drums, steady, ancient, trumpet blast — long, commanding]
(Verse 1)
The watchmen cry from broken walls,
The trumpet sounds, the remnant calls.
The earth trembles beneath His path,
The Living Word, His word is a staff.
From dust to dawn, from fear to flame,
We rise at the calling of His Name.
The kingdoms of men begins to fall,
As truth advances, sounding the call.
Lift your eyes, the King draws near,
Perfect love drives out the fear.
The voice of heaven tears the night,
Calling sons and daughters into light.
(Chorus — War Declaration)
LONG LIVE THE ONE TRUE KING!
LET THE HORN SOUND LOUD!
THE WORD OF TRUTH GOES FORTH TO FIGHT!
STAND AS ONE!
THE BATTLE IS THE LORD’S
BRINGING ALL THINGS INTO LIGHT
(Verse 2)
The nations rage, the proud arise,
Yet every lie before Him dies.
Not by the sword of mortal hand,
But by His word the kings are judged and stand.
He seals His own with fire and truth,
Refines the old, restores the youth.
Through trial, flame, and pressing night,
They overcome by His holy light.
(Pre-Chorus)
Feet upon the ancient stone,
We do not march as flesh alone.
The Spirit breathes, the Word commands,
Victory rests in nail-scarred hands.
LONG LIVE THE ONE TRUE KING!
LET THE HORN SOUND LOUD!
THE WORD OF TRUTH GOES FORTH TO FIGHT!
STAND AS ONE!
THE BATTLE IS THE LORD’S
BRINGING ALL THINGS INTO LIGHT
[instrumental Solo]
[Bridge - Low Ritual Chant]
[Drums double — trumpets answer]
(Breakdown - Command)
Do not retreat, do not delay,
The Lamb who died has cleared the way.
By His blood and by His word,
The voice of heaven is heard.
THERE IS ONLY ONE
KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS!
THE EARTH BOWS DOWN BEFORE HIS WORD!
THE WAR IS WON
HIS KINGDOM COMES!
From age to age His truth remains,
YahuShua forever reigns.
LONG LIVE THE ONE TRUE KING!
LET THE HORN SOUND LOUD!
THE WORD OF TRUTH GOES FORTH TO FIGHT!
STAND AS ONE!
THE BATTLE IS THE LORD’S
BRINGING ALL THINGS INTO LIGHT
